content:
**collectLane reports unreadable worktrees; session-start preserves hydration failure cause**

Fixed two observability gaps from the #864 audit. #921: collectLane() used to drop a worktree whose git status failed with no record — added skippedWorktrees:[{path,reason}] to its return shape, forwarded through shipLane() and printed on stderr by both the collect and ship CLI ops (unconditionally, so the SessionEnd trigger's log picks it up via its existing stdout+stderr redirection, no code change needed there). #923: step2HydrateEngram() used to collapse every failure to a bare {ok:false} — now returns {ok:false, reason} from stderr/exit-code/exception-message, surfaced additively by renderContextBlock(). step5SynthesizeContext stays deliberately unwired — recorded as an open product decision linked to #267, not resolved here. Full npm test 5285/5285 green under GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null (baseline 5277/5277, net +8 tests). Also fixed a pinned-line allowlist row in chunk-boundary.test.mjs that shifted because cli.mjs grew. See openspec/changes/issue-921-923-observability/.
